scheme_name: Advance For Purchase Or Construction Of House (APB&OCWWB)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh
The applicant must be registered with the Labour Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB)
The applicant must have an active registered worker membership for at least 5 years
The applicant must have at least 15 years of service before superannuation/retirement
The applicant must be able to repay the principal amount of the loan with a minimum interest rate or with interest in equal installments as may be fixed by the board
benefits_summary: Registered workers receive a cash assistance of ₹1.00 lakh.
